protocol.reproducibility: Fixed data, seeds, initial weights and batch order; MPS indexing gradients are not bitwise deterministic
protocol.loss: Legal candidate CE + 0.5 bounded value MSE + 0.25 auxiliary CE for reconstruct/predict only
protocol.auxiliary: Four fixed distinct uniformly sampled legal actions per board, or all if fewer; same in all fits
protocol.aux_loss: Equal weight per example-action to mean changed-square and unchanged-square CE; masks from true transition
protocol.targets: predict: successor pieces in original mover perspective; reconstruct: current pieces; other arms aux weight zero
protocol.compute: Every arm computes and backpropagates through the auxiliary branch, including zero-weight controls
protocol.initialization: All recurrent modes have identical same-seed initial state; CNN starts with four copies of the same core
protocol.comparison: Recurrent aux arms match parameters and operations; CNN has more parameters at equal depth operations
protocol.split: Separate generated games; global dedup of pieces/side/castling/EP and mirrored equivalents; exclude all v1 states
protocol.inference: Four internal refinements per FEN, shared source/destination scorer, no search or across-move memory
protocol.regret: Secondary: fresh unrestricted and each unique chosen root move at fixed nodes; bounded tanh score difference, can be negative
protocol.selection: Final checkpoints only, no early stopping, retries, budget extension or test-driven depth selection
protocol.evaluation: Every final fit on all dev and shifted positions; both are development, not untouched confirmation

continuation_gate.scope: Descriptive development gate only; fresh confirmation required for efficacy claims

protocol.claim_scope: Dynamics-supervised representation learning; no novel planning, world-model control, biological or Elo claim
